To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

EUSC is a novel concept that has not previously been studied in depth; the requirements for EUSCs tools are not well defined; we have defined a set of requirements for such tools; the requirements we have identified have not previously been identified in any other work.

the requirements for EUSCs include: (1) the ability to compose services of different types; (2) the ability to control data flow; (3) the ability to reuse templates; (4) the ability to create a composite service in multiple ways; and (5) the ability to use the composite services.

“End-user service composition (EUSC), where the user who creates the composite also uses it, has unique requirements, and these requirements can be elicited using a custom method that is based on the scenario based requirements analysis method.”
